entries.02eeca06168a8123: A business that handles commercial hygiene products used at restaurants, accommodation facilities, hospitals and nursing care facilities, as well as life care products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥39,174 million (¥40,478 million in the previous year), a decrease of 3.2% year on year. Sales of commercial hygiene products exceeded the previous year, as demand for kitchen cleaning agents and guest room consumables rose in food service and in accommodation and leisure. In medical and nursing care, sales grew at about the same rate as the previous year, affected by price competition with competitors. In August 2024, the company transferred its beverage business. This business is a segment newly established by the organizational change effective January 1, 2025.

entries.221a7c122778b639: As its ideal state for 2030, Kao has set out 'Kao, a company with global value'. Building on the structural reforms and portfolio review carried out under its medium-term management plan 'K27', the company says it will concentrate management resources on areas of high social need where it can best demonstrate its strengths, and will accelerate the development of 'Global Sharp Top' businesses that make a world No.1 contribution to customers' critical needs.

entries.34ee662fae746e45: A business that handles products for household laundry, cleaning and hygiene, including laundry detergents, kitchen detergents, cleaning paper products, sanitary products and disposable diapers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥549,333 million (¥544,278 million in the previous year), an increase of 0.9% year on year. Fabric and home care products rose 3.6% year on year, as the improved version of the laundry detergent series "Attack Antibacterial EX" increased sales, helped by market growth and the effect of price revisions. Sanitary products fell 5.0%: the sanitary napkin brand "Laurier" exceeded the previous year, while the baby diaper brand "Merries" fell below the previous year due to competitive pressure in Asia. In June 2024, the company transferred its pet care business.

entries.41b80533717c1c46: A business that makes and sells chemical products made from oils and fats, as well as functional and information materials for industrial use, to other companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥405,681 million (¥375,623 million in the previous year); including intersegment internal revenue, revenue rose 7.2% year on year. Sales volume decreased, but price revisions in response to higher oil and fat raw material prices contributed significantly. Washing Systems, LLC is included in this business.
entries.46b9a49983c1bf00: The company's offerings are divided into two areas: the Global Consumer Care Business for consumers and the Chemical Business for businesses. The former comprises four reportable segments: Hygiene and Living Care, which covers detergents and disposable diapers; Health and Beauty Care, which covers shampoos and facial cleansers; Cosmetics Business, which covers counseling and self-service cosmetics; and Business Connected Business, which covers business-use hygiene products. The latter makes oleochemicals and surfactants made from fats and oils, functional materials such as water-reducing agents for concrete, and information materials such as toners and chemicals for semiconductor manufacturing. Approximately 2,800 people are involved in research and development, and precision interface control technology and other technologies form the basis of its product development.
entries.5470253b940a5b9c: Consumer products are sold mainly to retailers in Japan, and mainly to retailers and wholesalers overseas. Among cosmetics, counseling cosmetics are sold by customers to end consumers through counseling, and Kao also provides support for this. The Business Connected Business delivers business-use hygiene products to the food service, lodging and leisure, and medical and nursing care fields. The customers of the Chemical Business are product users and distributors. There is no single external customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue. Dividing external revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 by customer location, Japan accounts for ¥945,050 million, Asia ¥349,030 million, the Americas ¥212,435 million and Europe ¥182,118 million.

entries.63235fd1c64eac9b: Kao states that its proprietary technology base, starting with precision interface control technology, makes it possible to achieve both environmental load reduction and higher added value, and that it is a source of competitive advantage in global markets. It also says that the use of scientific marketing, digital technology and AI will improve the quality and speed of decision-making from research and development through business operations.

entries.683524c6ead240bf: A business that handles counseling cosmetics (cosmetics sold in stores with beauty advisers consulting customers) and self-selection cosmetics (cosmetics that consumers choose and buy on their own). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥261,563 million (¥244,102 million in the previous year), an increase of 7.2% year on year. In Japan, among the six focus brands, "Curél" and "KANEBO", which continued to perform well, "SOFINA", where new products contributed significantly, and "SENSAI", which captured inbound demand, contributed to higher sales. In Asia, sales in China rose well above the previous year, and in Thailand, "KANEBO" and "KATE" exceeded plans. In Europe, "SENSAI" performed well, and the company is also strengthening the rollout of "Curél".

entries.73cf75ef32fdda70: A business that handles three product groups: skin care, such as facial cleansers, bar soaps and UV care products; hair care, such as shampoos and hair colorants; and personal health, such as bath additives and toothpaste. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥432,882 million (¥423,967 million in the previous year), an increase of 2.1% year on year. In skin care, seasonal UV care and sheet-related products performed well in Japan, and in hair care, the high-price brands "melt" and "THE ANSWER", launched in Japan in the previous year, contributed greatly to higher sales. In personal health, "PUORA carbonated toothpaste" performed well in Japan. On the other hand, products for hair salons in Europe and the United States fell below the previous year.

entries.8e8350909da0e5a4: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥120,081 million, up 11.4% from ¥107,767 million in the previous fiscal year. In the consumer business, while consumers show a preference for low prices, demand for practical and high-value-added products remained solid, and the company worked on proposing high-value-added products and on price revisions. Revenue of the Chemical Business includes revenue from sales to the Global Consumer Care Business. On a consolidated basis, this internal revenue is eliminated, and the eliminated amount is ¥45,840 million. The accounting standard is International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
entries.ac48c9f8517eed88: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,688,633 million, up 3.7% from ¥1,628,448 million in the previous fiscal year. Excluding the effect of exchange rates, the increase was 3.7%, broken down as 0.5% from volume and other factors and 3.2% from prices. External revenue was ¥1,282,952 million for the Global Consumer Care Business and ¥405,681 million for the Chemical Business, where sales volume declined while price revisions in response to rising fats and oils raw material prices contributed significantly. Products are recognized as revenue when delivered to the location designated by the customer, and rebates conditional on achieving sales volume or sales amount targets are deducted from revenue. Overseas revenue accounted for 42.9% of revenue (43.3% in the previous fiscal year).

entries.c423eef2739923a9: A business division that makes and sells products for general consumers, including detergents, cosmetics, hair care and hygiene products. Together these are referred to as the four reportable segments: Hygiene and Living Care, Health and Beauty Care, Cosmetics, and Business Connected. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025, totaling the four segments, was ¥1,282,952 million (¥1,252,825 million in the previous year), an increase of 2.4% year on year. Revenue by region was ¥858.5 billion in Japan, ¥210.8 billion in Asia, ¥119.9 billion in the Americas and ¥93.8 billion in Europe. While consumers have a low-price orientation, demand for practical and high-value-added products remained firm, and the company worked on proposing high-value-added products and on price revisions.

entries.fcd1bc4a2fe49500: Kao Corporation forms a group with 111 subsidiaries and seven affiliates (as of December 31, 2025). In Japan, Kao Group Customer Marketing Co., Ltd., which handles sales, Kanebo Cosmetics Inc. for cosmetics, Kao Professional Services Co., Ltd. for business-use hygiene products, and Kao Logistics Co., Ltd. for logistics support the business. Nivea-Kao Co., Ltd. (40.0% of voting rights held) is an equity-method affiliate. Overseas, Kao (China) Investment Co., Ltd. in China oversees affiliated companies, and Kao USA Inc. in the United States, Kao Germany GmbH in Germany, Kao Industrial (Thailand) Co., Ltd. in Thailand and others operate businesses in their respective regions.
